integrated_automatic_acceptance: Exact final source/run/artifact identities must be read from the candidate PR and immutable CI receipts; no result is transferred by this matrix.

requirements.title: Documents and OCR
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Existing isolated import/conversion stack, explicit encodings, managed language/model packs and bounded legacy adapters; exact EML metadata, CHM member recovery and strict ODF page-layout handling.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Actual selected-tool runs, precise format/fixture limits and separate language/model acceptance; arbitrary document fidelity and all OCR languages are not inferred.

requirements.title: Reading preparation
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Immutable originals, editable/versioned narration, source mapping, pronunciation, scoped rules and explicit preparation modes through the existing reader.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Language-specific pronunciation/stress quality and actual engine prosody need qualified voices and human review.

requirements.title: Voices and live reading
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: One VoiceRegistry with actual native SAPI, explicit reviewed local profiles, the owner-specific worker adapter and the distinct generic helper protocol; live reading and retained playback.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Exact owner-runtime routes and post-render/process integrity are source-reviewed and awaiting their new regression run; real owner voices, legacy drivers, hardware and acoustic quality remain separately qualified.

requirements.title: Audiobooks and scenes
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Current narration, role/scene projects, batch jobs, chunk identity, durable publication, output formats, chapters, stems and measured duration through the shared renderer.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Each actual voice/model/codec pair and long-form listening quality needs its own evidence; synthetic audio duration is not neural-generation throughput.

requirements.title: Studio and player
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Native track/clip/time controls, non-destructive editing, effects chains, local playback, recording/monitor interfaces and exact output-frame/media validation.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Physical microphone/output/monitoring, real-time device behavior and professional listening/NVDA acceptance remain distinct from automated PCM/effect tests.

requirements.title: Save and recovery
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: One Save All coordinator, current complete/incremental backups, passive canonical history, retained pending inputs and explicit restore/resume review.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Actual device power-loss/manual desktop recovery and declared per-pack redistribution remain separate; old state is not silently activated.

requirements.title: Scale
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Bounded paging, continuation, streaming originals and current catalog/query optimization; source-bound Windows measurements complete 1k/10k/50k synthetic edition traversal.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: The fixture shares one tiny original. Real diverse books, millions of segments, large-file throughput and declared user hardware require additional measured corpora.

requirements.title: Research and citations
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Scoped scientific search/evidence, bibliographic metadata, CSL, exports, acquisition adapters and Word citation boundaries through existing owners.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Actual licensed Word/Zotero/editor interoperability and lawful real-corpus relevance are separately recorded; controlled COM tests do not qualify installed Office.

requirements.title: Local assistant
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Deterministic plans, reviewed local-LLM proposals, typed bounded tools, one durable executor, explicit scope/budgets and reapproval after changes.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: A real approved local model and multilingual tool-selection/hardware benchmarks are needed for model-planning qualification.

requirements.title: Native accessibility
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Current native wx menus, dialogs, focus handling, command registry, keymap migration, Save and status/progress controls.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Automated native controls do not substitute for real Windows 11/NVDA keyboard use or complete Ukrainian/Slovak UI localization.

requirements.title: Optional providers
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Existing profile store, Windows credential references, allowlisted gateway, transfer/cost approval, budgets and durable request/recovery identity.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Real account/model availability and live paid calls require explicit owner configuration/authorization; no service is enabled by this code.

requirements.title: Local music
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Current selected music adapters, actual MIDI control assertions, licensed-asset/profile boundaries, stems and local generation orchestration.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Real approved neural weights, hardware, output quality and per-asset rights remain required; MIDI is not neural music.

requirements.title: Production director
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Approved typed script/scene plans call existing voice/music/effect/render/publication services and retain completed output identities.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: End-to-end neural multi-voice/music quality and creative model selection await actual qualified engines; model text never grants arbitrary execution.

requirements.title: Long production and profiles
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Bounded long-audio assembly, checkpoints, measured frame/duration verification and separate usage/rights profiles.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Hours of original neural generation, sustained GPU/VRAM/load cost and compatible model rights are not established by streaming assembly tests.

requirements.title: 135-language target
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: One derived canonical 135-entry catalog and per-feature/per-engine status matrix; no independent replacement catalog.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Every relevant voice/model/language pair needs real qualification; a catalog or route entry is not proof of speech, cloning, ASR, translation or OCR quality.

requirements.title: Security and privacy
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Current trust/admission boundaries, immutable assets, bounded filesystem/process handling, credential isolation and reviewed signed-client primitives.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Private service integration, deployment threat review and actual release profile remain separate; no confidential runtime/keys are published.

requirements.title: Rights and attribution
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Exact current dependency/runtime provenance, component notices and independent model/voice/asset rights records.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Per-profile distribution clearance, owner-approved legal terms, signing and publisher configuration are required before a distributable release.

requirements.title: Standard install and updates
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: One ordinary Inno installer and signed managed transaction, protected state, generation leases, rollback/recovery and the distinct original→maintenance→candidate proof.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Only exact actual installer/managed/restart/library receipts qualify the cohort. Historical direct-original managed failure remains explicit; production authority is not configured.

requirements.title: Audible progress
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: One measured progress contract, native status and explicit optional voice feedback, quiet/media ownership and durable completion boundaries.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Real NVDA progress announcements and absence of device/audio contamination require physical/manual evidence.

requirements.title: Complementary workflows
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Supplied ASR host, synchronized publication/reading, translation scopes, typed workflow templates, diagnostics and declared project interchange.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Actual external readers, EPUBCheck/DAISY/Braille/table packs, optional watchers/plugins, tactile output and ASR-based acoustic QA must retain their own implemented/qualified status; no blanket completion is claimed.

requirements.title: Owner voice cloning
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Current owner-specific adapter and reviewed engine/profile boundary reuse the supplied engine interface; private samples/models remain external.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: The professional consent/reference/profile and multilingual cloning workflow requires the actual owner-engine contract/assets, authorized samples and real intelligibility/similarity/control evidence; not replaced by a registered SAPI voice.

requirements.title: Entitlements and translation
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Neutral external contract plus current signed-client/offline-refresh/recovery boundaries, separated from update activation and official Google/local translation adapters.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Real private authority/account endpoints, policies and authorization; actual selected translation models/providers and independent rights/quality.

requirements.title: Supplied transcription
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Reviewed supplied V4.3/V5 worker profiles, real isolated synthetic protocol interoperability, content-bound originals/cache/receipts, TXT/SRT/VTT/JSON, edits, cancellation/resume and recovery.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: The supplied source is available and reviewed. Actual installed recognition weights, acoustics/timestamps/language quality, diarization and hardware are separate, not a generic missing-project blocker.

requirements.title: Retained library contracts
requirements.declared_implemented_scope: Independent libraries/collections, topics/notes, exact raw source evidence, scoped retrieval, export/no-clobber and verified restoration.
requirements.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Real lawful corpus acceptance, semantic relevance, actual NVDA and declared release artifact/rights gates remain independently required.

limits: A requirement title or implemented adapter does not qualify every detailed bullet in the specification.
An old passing artifact remains tied to its own source/tree/runtime/pack, even when current source is derived from it.
Real models, physical hardware, human accessibility/quality and production rights/authority cannot be manufactured by synthetic tests.
No public binary release, private-source publication, paid request or account deployment is authorized by this record.
